decisions.reason: Two years of investment and its fit with the firm's announced digital-twin direction lead management to persist with it despite limited public visibility.
Sunk costs from development and its proximity to the established offer justify continuing it, even though its website presence remains weak.
The multi-model product line represents substantial prior investment and is central to the open, extensible component strategy, making withdrawal unlikely.
The public launch announcement and close fit with the established offer create a visible commitment that strongly discourages discontinuation.
Its dedicated web page and direct extension of the established consulting business create enough commitment to keep the newly launched workshop on the market.
